main_body: multi-gable timber-framed house with tiled roof
top_band: red-brown and golden-yellow tiled roof slopes from row 0 to 63 (and down to 78 on the eaves)
evidence: The tiled roof slopes are clearly seen from above (rows 0-63/78) sitting above the vertical timber-framed south wall faces (rows 64-142), with eave shadows under the roof overhangs and recessed windows and doors.

style.evidence: The candidate is a genuine Beodeul building piece using the exact same roof tile ramp (6 steps from pale yellow highlight to dark maroon-brown), speckled plaster texture, timber framing, and dark brown/maroon material outlines as the references.
